name: g_shopEquipSlotFilterTable
comment: Lookup table of 6 item-filter predicate function pointers corresponding to equipment slots 0..5 (0: weapon Item_IsWeapon, 1: shield func_0066CCE8, 2: headgear func_0066C974, 3: body armor func_0066C94C, 4: accessory 1 func_0066C180, 5: accessory 2 func_0066C180). Used by Shop_BuildFilteredItemList when building candidate item lists for equipment windows.
evidence: Referenced at literal 0x0017B58C in Shop_BuildFilteredItemList (0x0017B174), called from Ui_EquipWindow_HandleInput (0x00333BEC) and Ui_EquipWindow_MoveCursor (0x00334B84). The function indexes this table as *(code **)(0x00729B50 + filterIndex * 4) for slot index 0..5 to test candidate shop/bag items against the slot category requirements. For slot 1 (off-hand/shield), func_006293E8 checks for dual-wielding and overrides the callback to 0x005A610C (allowing matching 1H weapons). Exactly 6 function pointers (24 bytes = 0x18) at 0x00729B50..0x00729B68 in rodata_00725000.s: [0]=Item_IsWeapon (0x005A60E0, cat 0..9), [1]=0x0066CCE8 (cat 0x0A..0x0B), [2]=0x0066C974 (cat 0x0C), [3]=0x0066C94C (cat 0x0D), [4]=0x0066C180 (cat 0x0E), [5]=0x0066C180 (cat 0x0E).

name: g_shopPartyEquipSlotFilterTable
comment: Party-inventory variant of the 6-entry equipment-slot filter predicate table (identical callbacks for slots 0..5: weapon, shield, headgear, body armor, accessory 1, accessory 2). Used by Shop_BuildFilteredItemListByParty to filter candidate items from party member inventory.
evidence: Referenced at literal 0x0017B980 in Shop_BuildFilteredItemListByParty (0x0017B59C), called from Ui_EquipListWindow_RebuildEntries (0x004AB170). The function indexes this table as *(code **)(0x00729B68 + filterIndex * 4) for slot index 0..5 to filter items in party member inventory. Exactly 6 function pointers (24 bytes = 0x18) at 0x00729B68..0x00729B80 in rodata_00725000.s, identical in contents to g_shopEquipSlotFilterTable (0x00729B50): [0]=Item_IsWeapon (0x005A60E0), [1]=0x0066CCE8, [2]=0x0066C974, [3]=0x0066C94C, [4]=0x0066C180, [5]=0x0066C180.
